.ba-col.bad { background: rgba(255,80,80,0.08) !important; border-color: rgba(255,80,80,0.25) !important; } .ba-col.good { background: rgba(68,245,255,0.08) !important; border-color: rgba(68,245,255,0.3) !important; } .ba-score { color: var(--accent); }
